author: 曹植
book_description: 曹子建集 with classical Chinese as the main text and English, modern Japanese, and modern Chinese overlays.

translation_policy.scope: Complete ten-volume public-domain collection; do not reduce the task to only volumes five and six.
translation_policy.wenyan: Preserve every source character, volume, work title, order, source citation, and stanza boundary exactly.
translation_policy.en: Write accurate, literary but understandable modern English; preserve imagery, prosody-related structure, allusion, register, names, and dates.
translation_policy.ja_modern: Write natural contemporary Japanese with kana and normal inflection, not kanbun or a Han-character transcription.
translation_policy.zh_modern: Write clear modern Chinese that explains the source meaning and allusions without merely restating the classical wording.
translation_policy.poetry: Preserve line relationships, parallelism, and stanza logic; keep sequences and numbered parts explicitly separated.
translation_policy.notes: Keep source citations and later editorial matter distinguishable from Cao Zhi's text and do not invent commentary.
